title: 好好離職
subtitle: 12 句英文，好聚好散留後路

lines.say: Valeria, I quit. Friday is my last day. Bye.
lines.zh: Valeria，我不幹了，週五是最後一天。掰。

lines.say: …Excuse me? Friday? We have the big launch next week!
lines.zh: ……你說什麼？週五？我們下週有大型發表會耶！

lines.say: That's how not to leave a job. In one minute, I lost a reference and a friend.
lines.zh: 這是離職的錯誤示範。一分鐘內，我失去了推薦人，也失去了一個朋友。

lines.say: You might need your old boss again one day. So leave the door open.
lines.zh: 有一天你可能還會需要前老闆，所以要把門留著。

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for leaving a job the right way.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你好好離職的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for leaving a job the right way.

lines.say: Starting the conversation, giving your reason, sorting the practical details, and saying goodbye well.
lines.zh: 開啟對話、說明原因、處理實際細節，還有好好道別。

scenes.title: Start the talk
scenes.sub: 開口：先約時間，再說重點

lines.say: Part one: start the conversation.
lines.zh: 第一段：開啟對話。

lines.say: Never resign in the corridor, by text, or in the middle of a busy shift.
lines.zh: 千萬不要在走廊、用簡訊，或在忙碌的班中途提離職。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Could we have a quick chat in private? There's something I need to tell you.
scenes.meaning: 可以私下聊一下嗎？我有件事要跟你說

lines.say: Could we have a quick chat in private? There's something I need to tell you.
In private means just the two of you. Your manager will know it's serious.
lines.zh: in private 是只有你們兩個人，你的主管會知道事情很重要。

lines.say: Find a quiet room, and close the door.
lines.zh: 找個安靜的房間，把門關上。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could we have a quick chat in private? There's something I need to tell you.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: This isn't an easy conversation for me.
scenes.meaning: 這對我來說不是件容易開口的事
scenes.note: easy conversation ＝ 容易開口的對話

lines.say: Then prepare them, gently.
lines.zh: 接著溫和地讓對方有心理準備。

lines.say: This isn't an easy conversation for me.
This sentence shows respect. You're not happy to leave. It's hard for you too.
lines.zh: 這句話表示尊重：你不是開心地離開，你也很為難。

lines.say: A short pause after it helps.
lines.zh: 說完停一下會更好。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: This isn't an easy conversation for me.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I've decided to hand in my notice.
scenes.note: hand in my notice ＝ 提出離職

lines.say: And then, say it clearly.
lines.zh: 然後清楚地說出來。

lines.say: I've decided to hand in my notice.
Hand in your notice means officially tell your employer you're leaving.
lines.zh: hand in your notice 是正式告訴雇主你要離職。

lines.say: I've decided shows it's final. Not a question, not a negotiation.
lines.zh: I've decided 表示已經決定了，不是問題，也不是談判。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've decided to hand in my notice.
Part two: give your reason.
lines.zh: 第二段：說明原因。

lines.say: Keep it positive and short. This is not the time to complain.
lines.zh: 正面又簡短。現在不是抱怨的時候。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: I've been offered a position that's closer to what I studied.
scenes.meaning: 我拿到一個跟我所學比較相關的職位
scenes.note: be offered a position ＝ 獲得一個職位

lines.say: I've been offered a position that's closer to what I studied.
Talk about what you're going towards, not what you're running from.
lines.zh: 說你要去哪裡，不要說你在逃離什麼。

lines.say: Closer to what I studied is a reason nobody can argue with.
lines.zh: 跟所學比較相關，這個理由沒人能反駁。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've been offered a position that's closer to what I studied.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: It's nothing to do with the team. I've really enjoyed working here.
scenes.meaning: 跟團隊沒有關係，我在這裡工作真的很開心
scenes.note: nothing to do with ＝ 跟……沒關係

lines.say: Then reassure them.
lines.zh: 接著讓對方放心。

lines.say: It's nothing to do with the team. I've really enjoyed working here.
Nothing to do with the team means: please don't think it's your fault.
lines.zh: nothing to do with the team 是：請不要覺得是你們的問題。

lines.say: Managers worry about this. Saying it takes the pressure off.
lines.zh: 主管會擔心這點，說出來能讓對方鬆一口氣。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: It's nothing to do with the team. I've really enjoyed working here.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: It was a tough decision, but I feel the timing is right.
scenes.meaning: 這是個艱難的決定，但我覺得時機對了
scenes.note: the timing is right ＝ 時機對了

lines.say: And show you thought about it carefully.
lines.zh: 再表示你是深思熟慮過的。

lines.say: It was a tough decision, but I feel the timing is right.
Tough decision shows it wasn't easy to leave them.
lines.zh: tough decision 表示離開他們並不容易。

lines.say: The timing is right is calm and grown-up. No drama.
lines.zh: the timing is right 冷靜又成熟，不搞戲劇化。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It was a tough decision, but I feel the timing is right.
Let's try that again. The right way.
lines.zh: 我們重來一次，這次用對的方法。

lines.say: Valeria, could we have a quick chat in private? There's something I need to tell you.
lines.zh: Valeria，可以私下聊一下嗎？我有件事要跟你說。

lines.say: Of course. Come in, have a seat.
lines.zh: 當然，進來坐。

lines.say: This isn't an easy conversation for me. I've decided to hand in my notice.
lines.zh: 這對我來說不是件容易開口的事。我決定提出離職。

lines.say: Oh. I'm sorry to hear that. Can I ask why?
lines.zh: 喔，很遺憾聽到這個。可以問為什麼嗎？

lines.say: I've been offered a position that's closer to what I studied. It's nothing to do with the team.
lines.zh: 我拿到一個跟我所學比較相關的職位，跟團隊沒有關係。

lines.say: Same news, but she's still sitting there listening.
lines.zh: 一樣的消息，但她還坐在那裡聽你說。

lines.say: Part three: the practical details.
lines.zh: 第三段：實際的細節。

lines.say: Your manager's first thought is: who will do your job? Answer it before they ask.
lines.zh: 主管的第一個念頭是：誰來做你的工作？在對方開口前先回答。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: My last day would be the twenty-eighth, if that works for you.
scenes.meaning: 我的最後一天會是二十八號，如果你覺得可以的話
scenes.note: if that works for you ＝ 如果你方便的話

lines.say: My last day would be the twenty-eighth, if that works for you.
Give a clear date. Check your contract for how much notice you need.
lines.zh: 給一個明確的日期。看一下合約要提前多久通知。

lines.say: If that works for you sounds flexible, even when the date is fixed.
lines.zh: if that works for you 聽起來很有彈性，就算日期其實已經定了。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: My last day would be the twenty-eighth, if that works for you.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'm happy to help train whoever replaces me.
scenes.meaning: 我很樂意幫忙訓練接手我的人

lines.say: Then offer to help with the handover.
lines.zh: 接著主動幫忙交接。

lines.say: I'm happy to help train whoever replaces me.
Whoever replaces me means the new person, whoever it is.
lines.zh: whoever replaces me 是接替你的人，不管是誰。

lines.say: This is the sentence that makes managers relax.
lines.zh: 這句話會讓主管鬆一口氣。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'm happy to help train whoever replaces me.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: I'll put it in writing and email it to you today.
scenes.meaning: 我會寫成書面，今天 email 給你
scenes.note: put it in writing ＝ 寫成書面

lines.say: And make it official.
lines.zh: 然後讓它正式生效。

lines.say: I'll put it in writing and email it to you today.
In Ireland, you should always give written notice. A short, polite email is fine.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，一定要提供書面通知，一封簡短有禮貌的 email 就可以。

lines.say: Date, last day, thank you. Three lines.
lines.zh: 日期、最後一天、謝謝，三行就好。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'll put it in writing and email it to you today.
Part four: leave on good terms.
lines.zh: 第四段：好聚好散。

lines.say: The last week is what people remember. Make it a good one.
lines.zh: 大家記得的是最後一週，讓它美好一點。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Would you be willing to give me a reference in the future?
scenes.meaning: 以後你願意當我的推薦人嗎？

lines.say: Would you be willing to give me a reference in the future?
A reference is when your old boss tells a new employer you're good.
lines.zh: reference 是前老闆跟新雇主說你很好。

lines.say: Would you be willing is very polite. Ask now, while you're on good terms.
lines.zh: Would you be willing 非常有禮貌。趁現在關係好的時候問。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Would you be willing to give me a reference in the future?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: I've learned so much from you. Thank you for everything.
scenes.meaning: 我從你身上學到好多，謝謝你做的一切

lines.say: Then say thank you properly.
lines.zh: 接著好好說謝謝。

lines.say: I've learned so much from you. Thank you for everything.
Be specific if you can. What did they teach you?
lines.zh: 可以的話具體一點，對方教了你什麼？

lines.say: Everyone likes to hear that they made a difference.
lines.zh: 每個人都喜歡聽到自己帶來了改變。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I've learned so much from you. Thank you for everything.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: I hope our paths cross again.
scenes.meaning: 希望我們以後還會再遇到

lines.say: And the last line on your last day.
lines.zh: 最後一天的最後一句。

lines.say: I hope our paths cross again.
Our paths cross means we meet again, in work or in life.
lines.zh: our paths cross 是在工作或生活中再相遇。

lines.say: It's warm, and it leaves the door wide open.
lines.zh: 很溫暖，而且把門大大地留著。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I hope our paths cross again.
My last day would be the twenty-eighth, if that works for you. I'm happy to help train whoever replaces me.
lines.zh: 我的最後一天會是二十八號，如果你覺得可以的話。我很樂意幫忙訓練接手我的人。

lines.say: That would be a huge help, thank you.
lines.zh: 那幫了大忙，謝謝。

lines.say: Would you be willing to give me a reference in the future?
lines.zh: 以後你願意當我的推薦人嗎？

lines.say: Of course. You've done a great job here.
lines.zh: 當然，你在這裡表現很好。

lines.say: I've learned so much from you. Thank you for everything.
lines.zh: 我從你身上學到好多，謝謝你做的一切。

lines.say: A reference, a smooth handover, and a manager who's on your side.
lines.zh: 有推薦人、交接順利，主管還站在你這邊。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：離職時會聽到的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish phrases for your last week.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！最後一週會用到的兩句愛爾蘭話。

lines.say: In Ireland, when someone leaves a job, there's always a party.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，有人離職一定會辦派對。

lines.say: Are you having a leaving do?
A leaving do is a goodbye party, usually in the pub after work.
lines.zh: leaving do 是送別會，通常是下班後在 Pub。

lines.say: And on your last day, your colleagues will say this.
lines.zh: 最後一天，同事們會跟你說這句。

lines.say: Don't be a stranger!
It means: stay in contact, come and visit. We don't want to lose you.
lines.zh: 意思是：保持聯絡，回來看看我們，我們不想失去你。

lines.say: Don't be a stranger!
Now the whole conversation, start to finish. Say my lines!
lines.zh: 現在把整段對話從頭到尾演一遍。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Could we have a quick chat in private? This isn't an easy conversation for me. I've decided to hand in my notice.
lines.zh: 可以私下聊一下嗎？這對我來說不是件容易開口的事。我決定提出離職。

lines.say: Oh no. We'll miss you. What's next?
lines.zh: 喔不，我們會想你的。接下來要去哪？

lines.say: It was a tough decision, but I feel the timing is right. I'll put it in writing and email it to you today.
lines.zh: 這是個艱難的決定，但我覺得時機對了。我會寫成書面，今天 email 給你。

lines.say: Thank you for telling me properly. Are you having a leaving do?
lines.zh: 謝謝你好好地告訴我。你有要辦送別會嗎？

lines.say: Of course! I hope our paths cross again.
lines.zh: 當然！希望我們以後還會再遇到。

lines.say: Don't be a stranger!
lines.zh: 要常聯絡喔！

items: Could we have a quick chat in private? There's something I need to tell you.
This isn't an easy conversation for me.
I've decided to hand in my notice.
I've been offered a position that's closer to what I studied.
It's nothing to do with the team. I've really enjoyed working here.
It was a tough decision, but I feel the timing is right.
My last day would be the twenty-eighth, if that works for you.
I'm happy to help train whoever replaces me.
I'll put it in writing and email it to you today.
Would you be willing to give me a reference in the future?
I've learned so much from you. Thank you for everything.
I hope our paths cross again.

lines.say: Perfect! Clear, kind, and the door is still open.
lines.zh: 完美！清楚、體貼，門還留著。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them for the day you need them.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖存起來，等需要的那天用。

items: 📰 每天一則在地新聞練英文
🎮 單字小遊戲，約朋友一起玩
🔥 連續打卡、解鎖稱號、逛廣場
🎓 英文小教室：會話、片語、文法

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: And good luck with the new job! Don't be a stranger. Bye!
lines.zh: 祝你新工作順利！要常聯絡喔。Bye！
